_comment: Coverage ledger for the SL-ABI-V3 §5 tape transplant, gated by
notCarried: a wizard wz_deck_* entry point deliberately NOT carried into
sl_tape_*, with the reason. Empty is the good state — it means the
additions: an sl_tape_* entry point with no wizard counterpart, with the
reason it exists. Both lists are required so neither a dropped function
nor an invented one can pass unnoticed.

additions.name: sl_tape_count
additions.reason: Tapes and grid decks are separate index spaces in the merged engine, so a caller needs to ask how many tapes exist. Wizard had one deck array and a compile-time constant, and no equivalent getter.

additions.name: sl_tape_channels
additions.reason: The drain ring is interleaved at the tape's own width, so the host must know it to size a drain buffer and to open the take's WAV. Wizard's host knew the width implicitly because it chose the record channels itself; with a mainMix source the engine picks the width, so it has to be readable.

additions.name: sl_tape_state
additions.reason: Wizard published deck state through its HotFrame deck block, which v3 does not have yet (per-deck HotFrame fields are still zero-filled). Until it does, state has to be readable directly or the UI cannot tell recording from looping.

additions.name: sl_tape_record_cap_reached
additions.reason: Same as sl_tape_state — wizard surfaced the 256 MB cap flag via its HotFrame deck block. A cap that stops a recording with no way to observe it is the silent-truncation failure D-WZ-DECK-01 exists to make visible.

additions.name: sl_tape_set_tempo_mode
additions.reason: P3-2b-5 (TAPE-STRETCH.md): 0 timePitch / 1 timeStretch — what the one rate number DRIVES. Wizard's deck had varispeed only; pitch-preserving stretch is the merge's 'stretch and re-pitch every element to the master' made real for tapes, on scoopy's own Signalsmith stretcher.

additions.name: sl_tape_tempo_mode
additions.reason: The readback for sl_tape_set_tempo_mode, so the dispatcher and fixtures can verify what landed rather than trusting the send (the silent-refusal defect class params:check exists for).

additions.name: sl_tape_stretch_ready
additions.reason: The stretcher warms up ASYNC (~600 ms) and the render stays dry until it is warm; without an introspection point the fixture could only sleep-and-hope, and a UI lamp could never say why stretch has not engaged yet.
